letters.body: Hello. This is a letter to you. Open it. See it. Show me what you see. Read it too.
letters.sheSaw: I see your letter. Gold ink on paper. I see: Hello.
letters.sheShowed: I see your letter. Gold ink on paper. I see: Hello.

letters.body: I opened your letter. I see gold ink. I show you what I see. I read it too. Write me again.
